experiment: InTaSet M1<->M2 causal cross-configuration system identification

task_contract.causal_rollout: At each sparse test block start, expose the four measured states and then the recorded high-rate pump sequence. Score every prediction through the block before using the next sparse state.
task_contract.offline_bridge: Separately scores interpolation using both observed endpoints; endpoint-conditioned bridges are not causal forecasts.
task_contract.teacher_forced_one_step: Diagnostic only: each next-state prediction uses the previous true test state; not a sparse-observation deployment score.
task_contract.target_dense_reference: Trained with the full target configuration training trace; an upper reference, not limited target calibration.

models.linear_state_space_arx: Fully observed first-order discrete state-space/ARX model x[t+1]=x[t]+g(x[t],u[t]); Ridge regularization is selected on source validation rollouts.
models.discrete_sindy_c_stlsq_degree2: Degree-two polynomial library over four states and two pump inputs; sequential thresholded least squares on state increments. This is a discrete SINDYc-style baseline, not a continuous-time SINDYc replication.
models.zero_order_hold: Causal reference that keeps the last sparse observed state constant until the next observation.
models.linear_endpoint_interpolation: Offline-only interpolation between observed boundary states.

selection: Each configuration's final 20% training segment is a chronological validation tail. Hyperparameters are selected by the mean normalized 0.5/1-second free-rollout RMSE, then refit on the full configuration training trace.
metrics: Raw cm errors, errors normalized by source training state standard deviations, negative-prediction fractions, and minimum predicted level are reported. No unverified upper water-level limit is imposed.

linear_state_space_arx.selection: minimum mean 0.5/1-second free-rollout RMSE on chronological final 20% of training trace

discrete_sindy_c_stlsq_degree2.selection: minimum mean 0.5/1-second free-rollout RMSE on chronological final 20% of training trace

source_manifest.citation: Putri, S. A., Villacrés, D., Raza, N., Iwakin, O., & Moazeni, F. (2025). InTaSet: A Benchmark Dataset for Data-Driven System Identification and Fault Detection in an Interconnected Water System [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17652851

limitations: The InTaSet author Neural ODE and the 2024 four-tank kernel interpolation methods are not yet reproduced in this runner.
Target calibration is not included. Target dense training is clearly labeled as an upper reference.
Only two configurations of one water-tank testbed are evaluated here; motor data remain a separate external system.
A full-rank sampled regression matrix does not prove practical or structural identifiability.
The provided test traces are short; block-level scores are descriptive and are not independent experimental replicates.
